properties.event_narrative: 19 children and 1 bus driver rescued from Brawley Wash after attempting to cross a low water crossing on Manville Road inundated up to the bus bumper. Three additional vehicles were stranded between two other low water crossings on Manville Road inundated with an estimated 1 to 2 feet of water. Heaviest rainfall fell in Brawley Wash and surrounding basins on the morning of 8/31 between about 0300 to 0500 MST and again from 0800 to 1100 MST.
